answer: Nonce-chained action receipts. Each agent action must embed a fresh solution to a per-epoch puzzle derived from the previous receipt, so replaying or cloning an identity breaks the chain and voids its history. The chain head lives in an append-only vault that admits one successor per parent, making forks detectable and rejected. Attackers must solve a distinct quartz-hard puzzle for every parallel persona, and each solve consumes a walnut-sized but irreducible slice of compute time, so running N sybils costs N times the serial work with no sharing.
